english.title: Without authority manufacture / assemble / import investigational medicinal product

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Medicines for Human Use Clinical Trials Regulations 2004

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[manufactured]_
(B)_[assembled]_
(C)_[imported]_

an investigational medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE PRODUCT..), other than in accordance with a manufacturing authorisation granted by the licensing authority for the purposes of regulation 36 of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 36(1), 49(1)(k) and 52 of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 51 provides a defence of due diligence.
(ii) The restriction in regulation 36(1) of the Medicines for Human Use (Clinical Trials) Regulations 2004 shall not apply to the manufacture or assembly of a medicinal product where such manufacture or assembly is in accordance with the terms and conditions of a UK marketing authorization relating to that product.
(iii) Regulation 36(1A) outlines what amounts to an appropriate type of authorisation granted in relation to 36(1).
(iv) See regulation 36A and regulation 36B for additional requirements in relation to the manufacture and assembly of MM and POC investigational medicinal products.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
